additional_info.subject: 0429591 - ID0429591-DC/Si-D/IT-[ Y2/S1 313508370009] Faulty socket CRM:00314000174
additional_info.body:
Ciao Luca,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0429591
, opened for DC2 out of order on charger
RHfqDg
in Latina.
I checked the charger, and it showed one known issue from EcoG. The socket DC2 had an "invalid" pilot state, and the error message was "could not configure local station for slac":
As said, the issue is a known failure from EcoG, and currently one of the Top 5 field issues.
Solution is to install the EcoG Hotfix v1.4.11. I just installed it, and the outlet is back available:
As per EcoG statement, the Hotfix is solving the issue permanently. In case a future unavailability of outlet DC2 will appear again due to "could not configure local station for slac" with EcoG version 1.4.11, the recommendation is to replace the EcoG HW, but this does not look like the case.
Since issue is solved and both outlets are back in operation, I will proceed to close the issue.
With kind regards,
